_readme: World of July 28th, 1914 — consumed by game.js's maybeApplyEraOverrides().

entities: new polity codes (or renames of existing codes). name -> countryLookup, color -> map fill, flag -> countryFlagOverrides (relative key under assets/flags/, e.g. 'AUH/1914.png' — see assets/flags/ATTRIBUTION.md for sourcing).
countryReassignments: keyed by CURRENT EFFECTIVE owner code (so SOML/disputed-territory baseline overrides are honored); every shape owned by the key is reassigned to the value.

regionReassignments: whole-ADM1-region carve-outs applied AFTER the country pass; names matched case/diacritic-insensitively against world_regions.json; unknown names warn+skip harmlessly (variants included where geoBoundaries spelling is uncertain).

Known first-pass approximations, deliberately country-level: Alsace-Lorraine stays FRA (modern ADM1 'Grand Est' is far larger than the 1871 territory, and not further subdivided in world_regions.json); North Schleswig stays DNK (same over-breadth problem); South Tyrol/Trentino stays ITA (Italy's world_regions.json only has 5 broad macro-regions, not fine enough to isolate it from Veneto/Friuli); Eupen-Malmedy stays BEL (Belgium's world_regions.json groups the whole country into 3 Gewest/Region-level buckets here — MP1's world_regions.json/custom_geo.json were extended with a real 10-commune Eupen-Malmedy split, see Scripts/mp1_fetch_belgium_subregions.py, but this game's basemap is intentionally left untouched, per this project's standing MP2-stays-intact rule); PNG entirely GBR (NE quarter was German New Guinea); YEM entirely OTT (Aden was British); CHN keeps modern extent; Pacific micro-territories only where a clean single owner exists. Hejaz (Saudi Arabia's Makkah + Al Madinah regions) IS carved to OTT below, leaving Nejd (the rest of SAU) independent.

Poland does not appear as a country anywhere in this preset: POL is reassigned wholesale to RUS (the Russian partition/'Congress Poland') in countryReassignments, with the German partition (Greater Poland/Posen, West/Pomeranian, Kuyavian-Pomeranian, Warmian-Masurian, Lower Silesian, Opole, Silesian) carved to DEU and the Austrian partition (Lesser Poland, Subcarpathian — Galicia) carved to AUH in regionReassignments.POL.
